title: No Search Bar
description: This mod removes search bar from all tabs except vanilla search tab(forge)
body:
It can be very frustrating when you can't close the inventory with the E key, because of an unwanted Search bar. This mod fixes the issue by removing the search bar from all creative tabs except the Search tab (configurable).

⚠️WARNING⚠️
Fabric versions of this mod always disable vanilla search bar, because fabric has no moded search bar feature.
